The exciton centre of mass is a Gaussian state \(\psi\propto e^{-r^2/2\ell^2}\), and the coupling is smoothed over the internal exciton size \(\sigma\): \[ E(\ell)=\frac{\hbar^2}{2M\ell^2}-\frac{E_p^0A_{\mathrm{cell}}}{2\pi(\ell^2+2\sigma^2)},\qquad g=\frac{E_p^0A_{\mathrm{cell}}M}{\pi\hbar^2}. \] For \(\sigma\to0\), \(g\gt1\) is the collapse (self-trapping) condition; for \(g\lt1\) the energy is lowest at \(\ell\to\infty\) and the exciton stays free. \(E_p^0\) is the sum of the LA and LB binding energies of an exciton fully localized in one cell.

A monolayer control was also run.
